description: v0.4 candidate: what a string length bound counts. Each case is a scenario, not signed bytes. A "command" case: on a fresh host, a registered person sends the action with the given value in the given field and every other field valid; for record.append, the company has a policy granting that person write and a private structural profile whose schema is the given "schema". A host must give the expected outcome: "accept" (the command succeeds), or a refusal with the given error code and HTTP status. Each value is described by its count of Unicode code points, UTF-16 code units and UTF-8 bytes; a host that counts code units or bytes instead of code points fails at least one case. The rule is in spec/v0.4/SPEC.md section 5 (String length). The registered profiles pin the same rule in their own fixtures (spec/profiles/party/1/fixtures.json).
rule: A dtp.schema/1 string maxLength, a command schema maxLength and every length bound a registered profile states count Unicode code points, as JSON Schema 2020-12 does. A character outside the Basic Multilingual Plane (U+10000 and above) is one code point, written as two UTF-16 code units and four UTF-8 bytes.
